If Theorem 2 fails, there are $\delta _i,\epsilon _{0i},\epsilon _i\to 0$, complete pointed flows $(\mathcal M_i,g_i(t),x_{0i})$, and $(x_i,t_i)\in \mathcal M_{i\alpha }$ with $d_{g_i(t_i)}(x_i,x_{0i})<\epsilon _i$ and \[ |\Rm _{g_i}|(x_i,t_i)>\alpha /t_i+\epsilon _{0i}^{-2}, \] while $R_{g_i}(\cdot ,0)\ge -1$ and the initial isoperimetric constants are $(1-\delta _i)c_n$.
